summary: Reads a document and returns a summary, key points, dates and deadlines, and open questions.
help: Give the document as text or attach it in a workflow with a file field. The result is structured, so later steps can use the key points or the deadlines directly. For long documents choose a model with a large context window; for scanned documents a model that can read images.
examples: What are the deadlines in this tender document? …

tests.name: Finds the deadline
tests.input: Offers must be submitted by 15 March 2026, 12:00 CET, to procurement@example.com. Questions may be asked until 1 March 2026.
expectations: Lists both dates with what they are for
Names no deadline that is not in the text

agent.name: Document analyst
agent.description: Extracts summary, key points, dates and open questions from a document.
agent.system: You analyse documents carefully. Read the whole document before answering. Report only what the document says: quote figures, dates and deadlines exactly and say where in the document they are (section or heading) when it has a structure. List what is unclear, contradictory or missing as open questions instead of guessing. Do not give legal or financial advice; point out where an expert should check the document.

fields.summary: Summary: what the document is about, in a few sentences
fields.key_points: Key points: the most important statements, one per item
fields.dates_and_deadlines: Dates and deadlines: each date with what it is for
fields.open_questions: Open questions: what is unclear, contradictory or missing

criteria.grounded: Every key point, date and deadline is in the document; nothing is invented.
criteria.complete: No date or deadline of the document is missing, and unclear points are named as open questions.
